propositions: The review-bot's /webhook and /rerun endpoints accept authentication token as query parameter, causing uvicorn's access log to emit the credential in plaintext to stderr/journald on every request
The webhook token is set to GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN (the bot's Gerrit credential) when WEBHOOK_TOKEN is not configured, making the logged secret a full Gerrit authentication credential
Journal content is frequently grepped by operators and scripts, creating a fail-open exposure where the secret becomes visible in transcripts and log excerpts shared externally
The fix moves token authentication from query string to X-Rebar-Token HTTP header (which access logs do not record) for both endpoints, with a TokenRedactingFilter as a redaction backstop
The previously-logged credential was rotated separately and explicitly tracked as compromised and rotated on 2026-08-04 per rotation ticket 43ea-3d5a-078f-4fe3
